title: Investigate Overconfident AI Answers
prompt: A conversational AI gives confident but incorrect answers on sensitive, high-risk topics. How would you investigate the failures and reduce harm while keeping useful answers available? Describe your evaluation and rollout plan.

response.placeholder: State your assumptions, then explain your approach and tradeoffs.
response.reference_answer:
This is a practice answer outline, not a reported interview solution.

Triage the most serious failures and define when to abstain or escalate while investigation proceeds. Build a reviewed evaluation set sliced by topic, user group and failure type. Measure factual correctness separately from calibrated uncertainty; assertive wording or model likelihood alone is not a trustworthy confidence score.

Trace failures through data, retrieval and generation using privacy-preserving logs. Compare targeted fixes such as improved evidence retrieval, citation checks, data remediation and decision thresholds. Test missing or conflicting evidence and cases where overblocking would suppress a useful answer. Roll out with expert review, monitoring and rollback; track serious errors, escalation quality and retained utility.
